# DREAMVISION Education

> DREAMVISION Education supports study in New Zealand and Australia, pre-arrival services, New Zealand and Australian nursing registration, ANMAC assessment, and Australian and New Zealand PR and visa-related support. The team has locations in Muvattupuzha and Kannur, Kerala.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://dreamvisionedu.au/): Overview of DREAMVISION services.
- [Services](https://dreamvisionedu.au/contact): Study, pre-arrival, nursing registration, ANMAC assessment, PR and visa support.
- [IQN theoretical exam preparation](https://dreamvisionedu.au/courses/iqn-training): Preparation information for the New Zealand IQN theoretical exam.
- [OET and IELTS preparation](https://dreamvisionedu.au/courses/oet-preparation): English-language exam preparation.
- [OSCE preparation](https://dreamvisionedu.au/courses/osce-training): Clinical assessment preparation.
- [OET training in Kerala](https://dreamvisionedu.au/best-oet-training-in-kerala): OET preparation for nurses across Kerala.
- [IQN training in Kerala](https://dreamvisionedu.au/best-iqn-training-in-kerala): NCNZ theoretical exam preparation.
- [OSCE NZ training in Kerala](https://dreamvisionedu.au/best-osce-training-in-kerala): Preparation for the NCNZ clinical assessment.
- [NCLEX-RN training in Kerala](https://dreamvisionedu.au/best-nclex-rn-training-in-kerala): Course information for nurses preparing for NCLEX-RN.
- [About DREAMVISION](https://dreamvisionedu.au/about): Organisation and service approach.
- [Contact](https://dreamvisionedu.au/contact): Enquiry options and office details.
- [Articles](https://dreamvisionedu.au/blog): Guidance articles about nursing registration and exam preparation.

## Notes
- DREAMVISION is independent and is not the Nursing Council of New Zealand.
- Immigration and visa advice should be obtained from a licensed immigration adviser or the relevant government authority.
